Name: Purchasable Clay (CP)
Author: Hikari014
Description:
[color=#ff7700][size=5][b]Overview[/b][/size][/color]
Tired of going back and forth and waste time farming clays in the mine? You can now just buy it in Robin's shop!

This is a continuation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8590]Purchasable Clay[/url], but instead of using the now-deprecated [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005]Shop Tile Framework[/url], it now completely relies on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]'s new functionality, thanks to the 1.6 update.

[color=#ff7700][size=5][b]Install[/b][/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[color=#ff7700][size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size][/color]
Inside [font=Courier New][color=#00ffff]config.json[/color][/font], you will find:

[list]
[*][font=Courier New][color=#00ffff]Price[/color][/font] : The Clay's price.
[*][font=Courier New][color=#00ffff]IncreasePriceOn2ndYear[/color][/font] : Whether to increase the price starting in the 2nd year, as with vanilla wood and stone.
[*][font=Courier New][color=#00ffff]PriceIncreaseMultiplier[/color][/font] : Price multiplier if the 2nd option is turned on.
[/list]
You can edit it manually using any text editor or using in-game [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]'s config menu.

[color=#ff7700][size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]
Should be compatible with 99% of mods out there, but if you find any issues, feel free to ask me in the comments tab.

[color=#ffff00][size=4][b][i]Have fun![/i][/b][/size][/color]

Downloads.Description: Unzip to Stardew Valley/Mods. Ensure you have both SMAPI and Content Patcher installed.
